text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the arcade with Bamboo
Memory, she suddenly stopped and began
looking around the area.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...! T-This is it!
...There's no doubt about it-ssu!!
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is this the shopping street from that school drama
I used to watch with my dad?! Whoa~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's so close to the academy, yet I didn't notice at all!
Ah, I see, they changed the shop signs for filming...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that Japanese sweets shop over there! That's where the protagonist and their rival bancho first met!
Ah, and over there is definitely the stage for the final battle...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this is way too nostalgic!
Trainer, I wanna look around some more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, swept along by an excited Bamboo Memory,
I ended up accompanying her on an unexpected
pilgrimage to her sacred sites.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Man, I'm so deeply moved!
Memories from when it aired
are all rushing back to me!
choice_data_list: Glad you had fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, guess it's about time to head back to the academy!
But, I wanna come back here again sometime—

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
“—Wh-Who on earth are you people?!
P-Please let me through!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY!! What do you think you're doing?!
No fighting allowed!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Student
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? B-Bamboo-senpai!
T-These people suddenly came up and picked a fight...!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What's that supposed to mean?!
Strutting around our turf like you own the place!
choice_data_list: Everyone, calm down a bit...
Everyone, calm down a little...

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Shut up! You got a problem with that, punk?!
Looking down on me just 'cause you're an elite...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal?! Of course I've got plenty to complain about!
I'm gonna beat down every last one of—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even close to done yet!
Next time, I'll leap across the ropes using just one hand and reach the goal~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh!
I almost lost control again, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Still, public morals are...! No, running wild is...!
Aaah, jeez! What am I supposed to do here~?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, a thought struck me. This situation...
isn't it straight out of one of those school drama shows...!?
choice_data_list: Could there be a hint to solving this in the drama's plot?
I wonder if the drama's plot might have a hint to solve this?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A drama... Ah!?
That's it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Hey! If you've got a problem with our students,
you can take it up with me!
...Assuming you've got the guts, that is!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The hell did you say~!? Are you underestimatin' me!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hah! If you're frustrated,
come and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*, *gasp*...! I can't do this anymore...!
There's no way we could ever outrun the academy kids...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, for someone talking like that, it looks like you've still got plenty in the tank!
Or did I misjudge you, huh?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wh-Why you...! Dammit, get back here!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Whew, what a run, what a run...!
Aaaah! That felt so good!!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Y-You dragged me through all that crap...!
I mean... sure, it feels refreshing, or rather,
I just stopped caring anymore, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I knew it, right?!
You don't need to get into fights—just running makes you feel this refreshed!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
From now on, whenever you're pissed off, come to the academy!
I'm Bamboo Memory, the Disciplinary Committee Head!
I'm ready to take you on anytime!

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Heh! Fine by me!
I'll be sure to remember that name!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Trainer! Thanks to you, everything went super well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If you clash with everything you've got until you're completely wiped out,
you're bound to understand each other! Just like in the dramas!
choice_data_list: That's a relief...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Back then, Dad and I were always the ones charging ahead, and Mom was the one holding us back. It always balanced out nicely, though.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, Trainer's the one keeping me in check.
That's how it feels~! Hehehe..."
choice_data_list: We make a great team!
We make a great team, don't we!
If it were you, I'm sure you could have managed on your own.
I'm sure you could have managed on your own somehow.
You've become even more admirable as the Disciplinary Committee head.
You've become even more admirable as the Disciplinary Committee head.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, Trainer's the one keeping me in check.
That's how it feels~! Hehehe..."
choice_data_list: We make a great team!
We make a great team, don't we!
If it were you, I'm sure you could have managed on your own.
I'm sure you could have managed on your own somehow.
You've become even more admirable as the Disciplinary Committee head.
You've become even more admirable as the Disciplinary Committee head.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Since we're here, let's scream
at the sunset together!
It's a reenactment of that TV drama scene~!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Together!
The two of us are unstoppableeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, facing the sunset,
we let out passionate shouts
until our voices went hoarse.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー!? Even if that went well,
I'd still hate it! It's fiery and exciting
because you're with me, Trainer! That's what makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We'll always be two halves of a whole! Definitely! That's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, with Bamboo Memory giving me a firm reminder, we bumped our fists together in a passionate pledge.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, you think so~?
Well, I did end up becoming
friends with them, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I gotta keep refining myself!
Growing bigger and broader, both as
Disciplinary Committee head and as a person—”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Going beyond "Class Rep" to become the "King of Morals"!
That's what I'm aiming for~!
